patch:
@@ -1,8 +1,7 @@
-# This is an example .goreleaser.yml file with some sane defaults.
-# Make sure to check the documentation at http://goreleaser.com
+---
 before:
   hooks:
-    - go mod tidy
+    - go mod tidy -compat=1.17
 
 release:
   prerelease: auto
@@ -33,7 +32,7 @@ builds:
     goarch:
       - arm
     goarm:
-      - 7
+      - "7"
     env:
       - CC=arm-linux-gnueabihf-gcc
       - CXX=arm-linux-gnueabihf-g++
